name: Level Nine (Level Nine Labs GmbH)
what: Designs synthetic nanozyme catalysts (ML-driven discovery) to turn biomass and waste into drop-in chemical building blocks, starting with polyurethane inputs.
homonym_note: Google News 'Level Nine' also hits unrelated San Jose real-estate and games items.

membership.basis: Listed on the live tomorrow.vc portfolio (tomorrow-2026); Visionaries Tomorrow led the March 2026 seed.
membership.quote: The funding round was led by Visionaries Tomorrow

entry.quote: raised €4 million in a seed round led by Visionaries Tomorrow

funding_rounds.round: Pre-seed (unannounced; implied by 'total funding to €6.5 million')

graduation_surfaces: googlenews: "Level Nine" catalysts -> only the March 2026 seed coverage (tech.eu, TFN, ESG Today, World Bio Market Insights) and a Sept 2026 Business Post founder profile; no later round
notes: Visionaries Tomorrow is new at the seed: the existing investors named are Zero Carbon and Rockstart, so the earlier ~EUR 2.5M (the gap to 'total funding to €6.5 million') did not include it; that earlier round's date and lead were not found (it may be partly grant money: the site credits IBB ProFIT funding). Founders Seadna Quigley and Dr. Emily Sheridan (ESG Today). Focus: green-chemistry catalysts replacing fossil feedstocks read as Climate & Energy; Industrial & Robotics is the alternative. Seed is 6 months old, so no graduation yet.
